messages.content: 一根載有2安培電流的電線，距離4米的點的磁場是多少？

function.name: calculate_wave_amplitude

message.content:
在距直導線4 公尺、電流為2 A的情況下，磁場大小可用安培環路定律計算：

\[
B=\frac{\mu_0 I}{2\pi r}
\]

其中  
- \(\mu_0 = 4\pi\times10^{-7}\,\text{T·m/A}\)（真空磁導率）  
- \(I = 2\,\text{A}\)  
- \(r = 4\,\text{m}\)

代入數值：

\[
B = \frac{4\pi\times10^{-7}\times 2}{2\pi\times 4}
  = \frac{8\pi\times10^{-7}}{8\pi}
  = 1\times10^{-7}\,\text{T}
\]

所以該點的磁場強度約為 **\(1\times10^{-7}\,\text{特斯拉}\)**（方向垂直於電流方向，遵循右手法則）。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "一根載有2安培電流的電線，距離4米的點的磁場是多少？" They want the magnetic field at a point 4 meters away from a straight wire carrying 2 A current. We need to compute B = μ0 I / (2π r). μ0 = 4π × 10^-7 T·m/A. So B = (4π × 10^-7 * 2) / (2π * 4) = (8π × 10^-7) / (8π) = 10^-7 T. So B = 1e-7 Tesla. The user didn't specify direction or units, but we can give magnitude. We should respond in Chinese. No tool usage needed.
